fix_commit.message: Bug 1945318 - Don't try to reparent an empty stack r=jandem
fix_commit.author: Matthew Gaudet

findings.title: Out-of-bounds access when reparenting empty stack chain
findings.message: When Error.captureStackTrace is called with a startAt function that hasn't been seen yet on the stack, the stackChain vector remains empty. However, the code for reparenting async stacks unconditionally accesses stackChain[stackChain.length() - 1], which causes an out-of-bounds access when stackChain is empty. The condition for entering the reparenting block checks multiple criteria (activation change, async stack presence, etc.) but fails to verify that stackChain actually contains frames to reparent.
findings.suggestion: Add a check for seenStartAt to the condition before attempting to reparent the stack. When Error.captureStackTrace is used with a startAt function, no frames are added to stackChain until that function is seen. The reparenting code must not execute when stackChain is empty.

ground_truth.root_cause: The introduction of the Error.captureStackTrace feature added a 'startAt' parameter that delays adding frames to the stackChain vector until a specific function is seen. The existing code for async stack reparenting was not updated to account for this new behavior, and unconditionally accesses stackChain[stackChain.length() - 1] without checking if frames have been added yet.

must_cover.reason: Contains the vulnerable out-of-bounds access at line 1622 where stackChain[stackChain.length() - 1] is accessed without checking if stackChain is empty. The reparenting logic assumes stackChain contains at least one frame.

Implements the startAt parameter logic that conditionally adds frames to stackChain only after seeing the startAt function. This is the root cause that allows stackChain to remain empty when the vulnerable code at line 1622 executes.

Entry point for Error.captureStackTrace API that introduces the startAt parameter. A reviewer examining this function would understand that startAt can delay frame collection, providing context for why stackChain might be empty.
